FN-0IBX6C-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 240
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Cynthia Almond
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/10/2023
House Bill 240 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Department
of Commerce to publish certain incentive project information on its website. The bill would not
otherwise affect state or local funding.

FN-0IBX6C-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 240
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Representative Cynthia Almond
Economic Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/19/2023
House Bill 240 as reported by the Committee on Fiscal Responsibility and Economic
Development would increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Commerce to
publish on the Department's website certain information for each project receiving Jobs Act
incentives.
Additionally, this bill would authorize the Joint Legislative Advisory Committee on Economic
Incentives to request a third-party evaluation be conducted assessing the impacts of state
economic development incentives in an Executive Report which could increase the obligations
of: (1) the Department of Commerce, the Department of Revenue and the Department of Labor,
to provide the requested data to the third-party conducting the evaluation; and (2) the Committee
by an undetermined amount, dependent the third-party evaluation selected and the costs incured
to produce the report, which presumably would be paid from the State General Fund.
